name: file-prompts
description: Suggested requests for a file, offered in its Ask AI panel and in a room whose workbench shows it (decks, documents, sheets, PDFs, Markdown, tables, images, video and audio), and for the part of it a member selects (a slide, cells, an image area, a time range, a passage of a PDF).

prompts.title: Tighten the wording
prompts.body: Tighten the wording on every slide: shorter titles, fewer words per bullet, the same meaning. Keep the layout and design.

prompts.title: Add speaker notes
prompts.body: Write speaker notes for each slide that has none: two to four sentences on what to say.

prompts.title: Make it consistent
prompts.body: Check the deck for inconsistent fonts, sizes, colours, alignment and capitalisation, and fix them.

prompts.title: Summarize the deck
prompts.body: Summarize this deck in five bullet points. Do not change the file.

prompts.title: Proofread
prompts.body: Proofread the document: fix spelling, grammar and punctuation without changing the meaning or the formatting.

prompts.title: Make it concise
prompts.body: Make the document more concise: cut repetition and filler, keep every point and the formatting.

prompts.title: Improve the structure
prompts.body: Improve the structure: clear headings, a logical order, one idea per paragraph. Keep the content.

prompts.title: Summarize
prompts.body: Summarize this document in five bullet points. Do not change the file.

prompts.title: Explain this workbook
prompts.body: Explain what this workbook contains and how its sheets relate. Do not change the file.

prompts.title: Check the formulas
prompts.body: Check the formulas and totals for errors or inconsistencies, fix them, and list what you changed.

prompts.title: Tidy the formatting
prompts.body: Make number formats, column widths and header styles consistent across the sheets. Keep every value.

prompts.title: Add a summary
prompts.body: Add a summary of the key figures (totals, averages, changes) where it fits best, using formulas.

prompts.title: Summarize
prompts.body: Summarize this PDF: the key points, the decisions and the open questions, on one page. Do not change the file.

prompts.title: Pull out the key figures
prompts.body: List the key figures and dates in this PDF as a table, each with the page it comes from.

prompts.title: Questions to ask
prompts.body: List the questions a careful reader should ask after reading this PDF, with the passage that raises each.

prompts.title: Proofread
prompts.body: Proofread this document: fix spelling, grammar and punctuation, keep the meaning and the Markdown.

prompts.title: Make it concise
prompts.body: Make this document more concise: cut repetition and filler, keep every point and the headings.

prompts.title: Turn it into slides
prompts.body: Turn this document into a short slide deck (.pptx), one idea per slide, with speaker notes.

prompts.title: Explain this table
prompts.body: Explain what this table holds: its columns, its rows and anything unusual. Do not change the file.

prompts.title: Find anomalies
prompts.body: Find missing values, duplicates and outliers in this table and list them by row.

prompts.title: Chart it
prompts.body: Make a chart of the most telling numbers in this table, as an image I can preview here.

prompts.title: Describe it
prompts.body: Describe this image: what it shows, its text, and anything notable. Do not change the file.

prompts.title: Make variations
prompts.body: Draw two variations of this image as new files, with the same subject and a different style. Leave this file as it is.

prompts.title: Summarize this video
prompts.body: Summarize this video: what happens, who speaks and the key points, on one page. Do not change the file.

prompts.title: Add captions
prompts.body: Add captions for all speech in the video.

prompts.title: Make a highlight clip
prompts.body: Make a short highlight clip (about 30 seconds) of the most important moments.

prompts.title: Transcribe it
prompts.body: Transcribe the audio, with timestamps, as a Markdown document.

prompts.title: Summarize it
prompts.body: Summarize the audio: the topics, the decisions and the open questions. Do not change the file.

prompts.title: Rewrite this
prompts.body: Rewrite the selected part to read more clearly. Keep its meaning, roughly its length, and the formatting around it.

prompts.title: Make it shorter
prompts.body: Make the selected part shorter: keep every point, cut the filler.

prompts.title: Expand it
prompts.body: Expand the selected part with more detail and an example, in the same style.

prompts.title: Fix the wording
prompts.body: Fix spelling, grammar and punctuation in the selected part only.

prompts.title: Tighten this slide
prompts.body: Tighten the selected slide: a sharper title, fewer words per bullet. Leave the other slides as they are.

prompts.title: Redesign this slide
prompts.body: Improve the layout of the selected slide: alignment, spacing and hierarchy. Keep its content and leave the other slides as they are.

prompts.title: Speaker notes for it
prompts.body: Write speaker notes for the selected slide: two to four sentences on what to say.

prompts.title: Explain these numbers
prompts.body: Explain what the selected cells show and anything unusual in them. Do not change the file.

prompts.title: Add a total
prompts.body: Add totals for the selected cells next to them, using formulas.

prompts.title: Chart these cells
prompts.body: Add a chart of the selected cells to the workbook, next to them.

prompts.title: Check these formulas
prompts.body: Check the formulas in the selected cells for errors and fix them; list what you changed.

prompts.title: Describe this part
prompts.body: Describe what is in the selected area of the image. Do not change the file.

prompts.title: Remove this
prompts.body: Edit this image with the image tool: remove what is in the selected area and fill it to match its surroundings. Publish it as this file's next version; leave the rest of the image as it is.

prompts.title: Enhance this part
prompts.body: Edit this image with the image tool: sharpen and clean up the selected area. Publish it as this file's next version; leave the rest of the image as it is.

prompts.title: Cut this part
prompts.body: Cut the selected time range out of the file and join what is left.

prompts.title: Describe this part
prompts.body: Describe what happens in the selected time range. Do not change the file.

prompts.title: Caption this part
prompts.body: Add captions for the speech in the selected time range.

prompts.title: Make a clip of this
prompts.body: Make a separate short clip of the selected time range.

prompts.title: Explain this passage
prompts.body: Explain the selected passage in plain words.

prompts.title: Summarize this
prompts.body: Summarize the selected passage in two or three sentences.

prompts.title: Translate this
prompts.body: Translate the selected passage into English.
